content:
sanjay: Deploybot triggered for Hummingbird dedicated tenant. Quiet window starts 23:00 UTC. Pinning version v2026.03.1 for dedicated nodes. @adele release notes: <https://redwood.internal/release/2026.03.1|release/2026.03.1>

deploybot: [1767774321] rollforward request accepted: tenant=hummingbird version=v2026.03.1 mode=canary slice=1. Watch: https://deploybot.redwood/1767774321 :rocket:

kai: Can we confirm KMS rotation won't collide with the quiet window? @allan

allan: Checked the KMS schedule — no rotation during the window. :white_check_mark:

novah: CS ops notified, they're standing by to watch latency and auth errors. Added hummingbird-cs to the incident channel.

sanjay: Starting canary slice now (slice-1). Expect ~5% traffic. Will post perf after ~3m warmup.

deploybot: slice-1 ready. instances: i-0abc1234, i-0def5678. Health=OK. latency_p50=48ms p95=210ms

kai: Seeing a p95 spike on embeddings endpoint at t+2m, investigating tail latency. @sanjay

sanjay: Acknowledged. Temporarily lower concurrency on canary pool and set batch_limit=8. Command: `redwoodctl set pool hummingbird-canary --concurrency 4 --batch-limit 8`

deploybot: concurrency update applied. New p95 observed 132ms at t+5m.

adele: Release notes updated with a short blurb about model quantization changes. cc @novah for CS-facing copy.

novah: :thumbsup: Added a short runbook and escalation steps to the release doc.

kai: No persistent 5xxs; only transient 429s. Rollback thresholds: >1% 5xx or >=30% sustained p95 regression for 5m. We're currently under thresholds.

sanjay: Canary looks stable. Requesting approval to scale to 50% traffic and continue switchover. @adele @allan please ack go/no-go.

adele: PM ack — go to 50% if SRE comfortable. :white_check_mark:

allan: Security OK, no KMS or key rotations impacted. :white_check_mark:

kai: SRE thumbs-up. We'll keep the auto-rollback guard at 1% 5xx. Proceeding to scale.

deploybot: scaling canary to 50% traffic. Expected completion ~2m.

deploybot: scale complete. Metrics steady. Preparing final rollforward to 100%.

sanjay: Rolling to full now. Command: `deploybot roll forward --tenant hummingbird --version v2026.03.1 --to=100%`

deploybot: rollforward completed. Old version v2026.02.9 tombstone in progress. No active alerts.

novah: CS notified of completion and where to find release notes/runbook. They will raise a ticket if customers see anomalies.

kai: I'll maintain a 30m watch on the latency dashboard; will trigger rollback if thresholds breach.

sanjay: Thanks everyone. Adding final postmortem notes and changelog pointers to the release document. Closing thread unless issues are reported. :wave:
